text: Runs list supports custom, reorderable columns and smart columns extracted via JSON path
quote: Show, hide, and reorder the columns on the runs list, and add smart columns that pull a value out of a run's payload, metadata, or output by JSON path.

text: Triggering a task returns a handle you can use to check status, cancel, or retry it
quote: This triggers the task and returns a handle...You can use the handle to check the status of the task, cancel and retry it.

text: Tasks can be configured to retry automatically with exponential backoff
quote: This task will retry 10 times with exponential backoff.

text: Scheduled tasks run recurringly using cron syntax
quote: Scheduled tasks are only for recurring tasks...A task that is triggered on a recurring schedule using cron syntax.

text: Waitpoint tokens pause a run until an external event/approval completes it
quote: Waitpoint tokens pause task runs until you complete the token. They're commonly used for approval workflows and other scenarios where you need to wait for external confirmation

text: Once a run starts it's locked to that code version, unaffected by later deploys
quote: When a task run starts it is locked to the latest version of the code (for that environment). Once locked it won't change versions, even if you deploy new versions.

text: Concurrency limit can be set per task queue to cap simultaneous executions
quote: You can set the concurrency limit for a task by setting the `concurrencyLimit` property on the task's queue. This limits the number of runs that can be executing at any one time

text: Dashboard shows real-time view of current limits, quotas, and rate-limit usage
quote: You can view your current limits, quotas, and rate limit usage in real-time by visiting the **Limits** page in the dashboard

text: Runs progress through tracked lifecycle states (pending, delayed, queued, dequeued, executing)
quote: A run can go through **various** states during its lifecycle...Pending version...Delayed...Queued...Dequeued...Executing

text: Live run updates and data streaming to frontend/backend without polling
quote: Get live run updates and stream data from background tasks to your frontend or backend. No polling.

text: Official MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Trigger.dev projects

text: Durable multi-turn AI chat tasks survive refreshes, deploys, and crashes

text: Installable agent skills teach AI coding assistants to write tasks, realtime frontends, and chat agents

text: Official CLI supports local development, self-hosting, and deployment

text: Self-hosting lets you run the platform on your own infrastructure with full control
quote: Self-hosting Trigger.dev means you run and manage the platform on your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your environment, deployment process, and the URLs you expose the service on.
